text: Figure 12.81: Modeling of the configuration for switching a function group state The relation to the actual function group on instance level is created by the existence of the FunctionGroupPortMapping, which identifies the actual function group, rep- resented by a ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype aggregated by a Function- GroupSet.
